articles.title: Bicycle procurement row deepens as AAP seeks transparency
articles.description: Delhi AAP president Saurabh Bharadwaj questioned the reported expenditure per bicycle and urged the government to disclose the make, model, tender specifications and procurement details. He said the issue was raised a day earlier, but neither Chief Minister Rekha Gupta nor Education Minister Ashish Sood responded

articles.title: NTA floats Rs 7.5-crore tender to bolster security after NEET paper leak row
articles.description: In the wake of the NEET-UG paper leak controversy, the National Testing Agency (NTA) has floated a Rs 7.5-crore tender for round-the-clock security services at its headquarters and regional offices. According to the tender document, the testing agency aims to safeguard NTA personnel, visitors, assets, premises, records, confidential examination material, server rooms, strong rooms and [...]

articles.title: YSRC Alleges TTD Relaxed Medicine Tender Norms to Favour Suppliers
articles.description: Former TTD chairman Bhumana Karunakar Reddy alleged that the Tirumala Tirupati Devasthanams eased eligibility norms for medicine procurement tenders to benefit select suppliers and sought an inquiry.

articles.title: India News | Apology for PM Video Removal Should Come from Mark Zuckerberg or Safe Harbour Protection Should Be Withdrawn: Parliamentary Panel Chief Nishikant Dubey
articles.description: Get latest articles and stories on India at LatestLY. Parliamentary Standing Committee on Communications and Information Technology Chairperson Nishikant Dubey on Monday said the committee has taken a serious view of removal from Facebook last month of Prime Minister Narendra Modi's video on action against examination paper leaks and Meta founder and CEO Mark Zuckerberg should tender an apologise and if this is not done the safe harbour protection under Section 79 "should be withdrawn".
